content.text: {"answer":"The Administrator and the Controller each produce a daily report of positions whose price has not changed. A price unchanged for three consecutive business days is flagged and investigated by the Controller; unchanged for five consecutive business days is escalated to the Chief Financial Officer; and unchanged for ten consecutive business days may not continue to be used without a fair value determination by the Valuation Committee. Positions subject to a trading halt are escalated immediately.","source_document":"03_valuation_policy.md","section":"Section 6.1 (Stale Price Reports)","quote":"The Administrator and the Controller each produce a daily report of positions whose price has not changed. A price that is unchanged for three consecutive business days is flagged and investigated by the Controller. A price that is unchanged for five consecutive business days is escalated to the Chief Financial Officer. A price that is unchanged for ten consecutive business days may not continue to be used without a fair value determination by the Committee. Positions subject to a trading halt are escalated immediately."}
